scope: Pure local synthetic dry-run category classification, not a live collector or activated retention policy.

helper.clock: Explicit aware datetime required. Created time must be aware and not in the future; fake-clock tests are separate from runtime time evidence.
helper.proposed_windows: Dictionary of known category to positive datetime.timedelta; empty dictionary allowed. No period is built in or activated.
helper.review_candidate_requires: Known non-protected category, known state outside state_hold, no holds, exact true boolean confirmed/recovery_complete, valid clock and elapsed explicit proposed window including equality.
helper.result_categories: Known categories or fixed UNKNOWN; never echo hostile supplied category/state/hold text.

privacy: Aggregate fixed codes/counts only; no source IDs, digests, content, free text, keys or per-record existence clues. A later collector must apply current permission/scope to inputs and output counts.
policy_requirements_before_any_dispositi: Separate custodian-approved category policy specifying duration, clock, holds, backup/key expiry, review and disposition; blueprint examples are unapproved proposals.
Preserve pending/unconfirmed Android operations, immutable revisions/correction reasons, failed recovery and legal/evaluation holds even after logout, revocation or expiry.
Never delete durable operation identity to allow duplicate acceptance, replay purged originals, or weaken immutable triggers/PROTECT to enable deletion.
Any future receipt/body/tombstone skeleton or digest minimization requires independent privacy/migration/replay review and separate approval.
REVIEW_CANDIDATE is classification only and cannot authorize deleting any row, blob, archive or key. Ledger growth remains a documented limitation.
